name: 2D Skew-Normal Parameter Projection
definition: Computes the parameters of a 2D Skew-Normal distribution (SN2D) resulting from the linear projection of a 3D Skew-Normal kernel (SN3) onto the image plane.
summary: 2D Skew-Normal Parameter Projection computes 2D kernel parameters from 3D inputs, preserving asymmetry to model one-sided surfaces and sharp boundaries unlike standard Gaussian splatting.
